description: To understand the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and compare their applicability. To collect and document the requirements for a software using applicable techniques. To create different levels of design using suitable strategies ensuring good design principles. To effectively test and maintain a software for ensuring software quality. To use AI in different phases of software development like requirement specification, coding & testing.

syllabus.title: Introduction and Problem Analysis
syllabus.body: Software crisis, software characteristics, and software processes; software life cycle models - build & fix, waterfall, prototype, evolutionary, spiral, agile model; problem analysis - requirements: types and analysis techniques like DFD, ER-diagrams, object-diagrams, SRS.

syllabus.title: Software Design
syllabus.body: Modularity, coupling vs. cohesion, design levels: architecture, high level design & low level design, strategy of design: function-oriented design, object-oriented design.

syllabus.title: Software Validation & Maintenance
syllabus.body: Software testing terminology, functional testing, structural testing, levels of testing; software maintenance: categories, models, regression testing, reverse engineering vs. re-engineering.

syllabus.title: Use of AI in Software Engineering
syllabus.body: AI-assisted requirement engineering using generative AI - prompts and prompting patterns, assessing the role of LLMs; generative AI for software development: code generation using LLM, generative AI enhanced software management.

outcomes: Apply the concepts to choose appropriate software process models as per user requirements.
Create a good quality SRS and design documents by choosing the suitable techniques.
Validate the implementation of the software as per customer needs.
Develop and maintain the software using traditional as well as AI techniques.
textbooks: K.K. Aggarwal, Yogesh Singh, Software Engineering, New Age International Ltd, Latest Edition.
Pankaj Jalote, An Integrated Approach to Software Engineering, Narosa Publishing, Latest Edition.
A. Nguyen-Duc, P Abrahamsson, F Khomh, Generative AI for Effective Software Development, Springer.
referenceBooks: Pressman, R.S. and Maxim, B.R., Software Engineering: A Practitioner's Approach, 9th ed., McGraw Hill, Latest Edition.
Sommerville, Ian, Software Engineering, Pearson Education, Latest Edition.
